# MissingGlyphException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Raised when text uses a character that no registered font can draw and the document's `settings.missingGlyphs` is `'throw'`. With the default, `'drop'`, the character is left out and a `font` warning is recorded instead.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BonniePdfError`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new MissingGlyphException(codePoints: readonly number[], fontName: string)
```

## Properties

- [`codePoints`](#codepoints): The code points no font could draw, up to eight, in the order they were met.
- [`fontName`](#fontname): The font the text asked for.
